wholeScope: Whole physical Dublin Tunnel twin-tube structure on native northbound/southbound underground alignments, with both northern and southern portal ends and intrinsic mouth canopies/retaining structures. Preserve both native physical routes/length, not a single photographed mouth. Use explicitly reconstructed physical tube/cut-cover sections from primary technical dimensions; native road centreline is a location axis, never a measured wall/roof footprint or a generic extruded surface building. Excludes wider motorway/toll plaza/property/neighborhood, detached control buildings, vehicles/signage and detailed/navigable interior.
scopeLimits: Native road axes are location controls only, not measured tube walls/canopy polygons.
Both complete twin routes and both portal ends required. A lone northern mouth does not complete the target.
Grade, hidden section transitions/other ends/portal geometry must be explicit estimates chosen only after originalfield freeze. No terrain refitting or invented site footprint.
Detailed navigation interiors/road network/toll plaza/detached control building excluded.
